name: Holding Grudges
overview: Scripture teaches that holding grudges is contrary to God's command to love our neighbors and to forgive others as He forgives us. Leviticus 19:18 explicitly forbids bearing grudges and calls believers to love their neighbors as themselves. The New Testament reinforces this by urging forgiveness in prayer and daily relationships, emphasizing that forgiving others is essential for receiving God's forgiveness (Matthew 6:14; Mark 11:25; Luke 17:3). Wisdom literature also highlights the virtue of patience and discretion in overlooking offenses rather than seeking revenge (Proverbs 19:11; Romans 12:17), guiding believers to respond to wrongs with grace rather than resentment.
